contacts.friction_row_basis: Step 1b: Coulomb stick/slip. The shared 1e-4 impedance made friction rows viscous (2.3 mm/s box creep at 10 deg; 13.4 mm/s tire creep on the 10 deg hold). impratio 1e6 removes friction regularization, and 1000/s direct row damping (4 physics steps at 0.25 ms) keeps the stick stable. Verified with a box: 0.004 mm/s creep below mu and exact (g sin - mu g cos) sliding at 45 and 60 deg. Foam tread shear compliance (~0.04 mm at hold loads) is neglected.
contacts.constitutive_scope: Nonzero unilateral material/contact springs; no base constraints or state clamps. Rate/print/patch/damping brackets are stated digital assumptions and tested sensitivities. Exceeding modeled travel or allowable is a failure, not force clipping
